title: Structured Decision Block - Input Payload v0.2
description: Universal input contract for the structured decision module. Any upstream analysis agent (Amazon or other) produces this payload after multi-dimensional mining. The decision module then synthesizes verdicts, scores, counter-evidence, and actionable recommendations.

scenario_id.description: Optional unique ID for this analysis run (e.g. keyword hash).

business_context.description: User goals, risk tolerance, and constraints that drive the decision logic.

risk_preference.description: Risk appetite. Affects how aggressively verdicts are given and what counts as 'acceptable'.

primary_goal.description: Main objective, e.g. '利润优先', '规模优先', '蓝海低竞争', '新品窗口期', '稳健现金流'.

weights.description: Optional custom weights (total should be ~100). If omitted, module uses scenario defaults.

hard_constraints.description: One-vote veto conditions expressed as human-readable rules (module will try to enforce).

dimensions.description: Core structured findings. Each dimension represents one axis of value/risk after upstream mining. Minimum 4-6 recommended for meaningful decisions.

name.description: Human-readable name in the target language.

value.description: The measured value. Prefer numeric when possible for scoring.

unit.description: Unit for the value, e.g. '% YoY', 'USD', 'count'.

score.description: Optional pre-computed score (0-10). Module may re-score based on business_context.

weight.description: Optional weight for this dimension (used if business_context.weights is not provided).

thresholds.description: Suggested thresholds for green/yellow/red. Module may adjust.

source.description: Atomic skill or data source, e.g. 'linkfox-aba-intelligent-query'

step.description: Optional step in upstream pipeline, e.g. 'S3.5'

potential_reversals.description: Hints for generating strong counter-evidence. Upstream should list concrete conditions that would flip this dimension's conclusion.

key_aggregates.description: Global summary metrics useful for overall scoring and veto logic. Not tied to a single dimension.

key_risks.description: Top risks surfaced during upstream analysis.

positive_signals.description: Notable positive signals (narrative or structured) that should influence the final verdict.

upstream_limitations.description: Data gaps, freshness issues, or methodological limitations from upstream.

raw_data_refs.description: Optional references to full artifacts for deeper inspection by the decision module or humans.
